decisions.topic: Lazy embedded-file listing and extraction-time checksum
decisions.review: Agree with keeping stream decoding off document-open/list paths: §7.11.4.1 says embedded bytes are for convenience and need not be directly processed by every PDF processor. Once extraction has decoded bytes, Table45 checksum is a direct applicable check; existing T62 now tests filtered/uncompressed semantics. The checksum is not a security verdict.

decisions.topic: External file confinement and caller-owned resolution
decisions.review: Retain restricted host fetch and archive reporting of the parsed file-spec value. Table43 F/UF precedence is already reviewed in file_specs_current and T132; no new host-open assertion is needed here. Resource bounds may produce a truthful refusal/report, but producer path restrictions alone do not require a parser to reject a file.

decisions.topic: Collection container remains visible; D outcome emphasizes a row
decisions.review: Keep as an explicit owner/presentation policy while D02 remains unresolved. Table153 requires the initial document be presented but does not prescribe that a row highlight satisfies presentation; Split/preview furniture is separately optional. Do not certify the ambiguity as conclusively resolved or as a defect.

decisions.topic: Collection schema columns and CI values
decisions.review: The recorded coverage gap is specific: Table153 details mode says all schema information is presented, Table155 S/D/N resolve through matching CI keys, and CompressedSize comes from stream Length. Existing source-derived exact-xref tests already expose the current B05/B06 omissions with direct values and independent controls. Do not add duplicate tests; parent should retain current failure status only as supported by the current run manifest.

No sorting defect revisited here. The value join is separate from sort assertions: a correct order does not prove a CI cell is presented. Prior collections review owns the exact sort conditions and tests.

decisions.topic: Optional split/navigator layout and effective clause identity
decisions.review: Preserve source modalities: Split/presentation furniture and navigator subfeatures include MAY/SHOULD clauses; producer requirements are not reader rejection commands. Effective EC3 #477 moves navigator material into §12.3.5.3 even though some local citations preserve published section labels. No new navigator finding is added.

decision: Six actual source tables were sampled: Table43 FileSpec subset, Tables44–45 embedded payload/parameters, Tables153–155 collection/schema/field. Current source and existing feature tests disclose the meaningful B05/B06 consumer gaps and T62/T132 covered behaviors. No additional valid-input behavior justified a new test draft. The D02 presentation question remains unresolved owner policy, not an ISO verdict.
